verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no editor plugin or extension API, typings, samples, or way to distribute extensions. The Code API controls exported scenes at runtime, the Code tab embeds one HTML document per file, and the MCP server lets AI clients drive the editor. These are adjacent features, not a plugin system for building and sharing editor extensions.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented plugin API with typings and samples lets me build and distribute my own editor extensions
